submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on the token that completes the name of a commercial business, at the end of a multi-token company name (Goldman [[Sachs]], General [[Motors]], Ford Motor [[Company]], Smith & [[Sons]], Johnson & [[Johnson]], Acme [[Corporation]]/Inc[[.]], Hers[[hey]], KPM[[G]], CI[[BC]], Al[[ibaba]], the autom[[aker]]), and on a possessive 's directly after such a name. It is silent on person names, places, non-commercial institutions (United Nations, Harvard), lowercase descriptors ('Smith & sons'), very famous single-token brands (Microsoft, Google, Apple, Ford), and every token of plain text has a floor of 0 (no first-token or positional activity).
